s: nakAraH । tavargapaYcamavarRaH vyaYjanaviMSavarRaSca । asyoccAraRasTAnaM dantaH । iti vyAkaraRam ॥ (yaTA, SikzAyAm । 17 । “dantyA xtulasAH smftAH ॥”) tatparyyAyaH । mezaH 2 dIrGI 3 sOriH 4 । iti bIjABiDAnam ॥ tatsvarUpam । yaTA, -- “nakAraM SfRu cArvvaNgi ! kowividyullatAkftim । paYcadevamayaM varRaM svayaM paramakuRqalI ॥ paYcaprARAtmakaM varRaM hfdi BAvaya pArvvati ! ॥” iti kAmaDenutantram ॥ “vAmataH kuRqalI reKA UrdDvADaHkramataH sTitA । candrasUryyAgnirUpA sA mAtrA vARI prakIrttitA ॥” tasya DyAnaM yaTA, varRodDAratantre । “DyAnamasya nakArasya vakzyate SfRu BAvini ! । dalitAYjanavarRABAM lalajjihvAM sulocanAm ॥ caturBujAM kowarAkzIM cArucandanacarccitAm । kfzRAmbaraparIDAnAmIzadDAsyamuKIM sadA ॥ evaM DyAtvA nakArantu tanmantraM daSaDA japet ॥” asya nAmAni yaTA, -- “no garjjinI kzamA sOrirvvAruRI viSvapAvanI । mezaSca savitA netraM danturo nArado'YjanaH ॥ UrdDvacAmI dviraRqaSca vAmapAdANgulermuKam । vEnateyastutirvvartmastaraRirvvAlirAgamaH ॥ vAmano jvAlinI dIrGo nirIhaH sugatirvviyat । SabdAtmA dIrGaGoRA ca hastinApuramecakO ॥ girinAyakanIlO ca Sivo'nAdirmmahAmatiH ॥” iti nAnAtantraSAstram ॥ (anubanDaviSezaH । yaTA, kavikalpadrume । “naH svAdiH po mucAdiH .” iti ॥ kAvyAdO asya praTamaprayoge PalaM yaTA, vftraratnAkarawIkAyAm । “do DaH sOKyaM mudaM naH suKaBayamaraRakleSaduHKaM pavargaH ॥”)

vya, nizeDaH । (yaTA, manuH । 6 । 47 । “ativAdAMstitikzeta nAvamanyeta kaYcana । nacemaM dehamASritya vEraM kurvvIta kenacit ॥”) upamA । iti medinI । ne 1 ॥ Adyasya paryyAyaH । nahi 2 a 3 no 4 aBAvaH 5 । ityamaraH । 3 । 4 । 11 ॥ anA 6 nA 7 । iti BarataH ॥ naYarTaSca ॥

puM, (namatIti । nama + anyezvapIti qaH .) sugataH । banDaH । dbiraRqaH । stutaH । iti medinI । ne, 1 ॥ ratnam । ityekAkzarakozaH ॥ dvitIyAcaturTIzazWIbahuvacanAntasyAsmacCabdasya sAntarUpo'yaYca ॥ (yaTA, mugDaboDe । “puzRAtu vo no'pi harirGanaM vo dadAtu no hantvaSuBAni vo naH ॥”)
v: avya॰ naha--vanDane naSa nASe--vA qa । 1 nizeDe 2 upamAyAM ca medi॰ 3 naYarTe ca । asya samAse nalopaH nuqAgamaSca na Bavati । “saMgrABe nAtikovidam” BA॰ vi॰ 4 a॰ । naYA samAse tu anAtakovadamiti syAt । ekayonA viMSatirityAdivAkye ekAdnaviMSatiH ekAnnaviMSatirityAdi । nAsatyO nAkEtyAdO ca naYaSabdasamAse'pi prakftivadBAvaviDAnAt na nalopAdi । nEkaDAnArAcanAntarIyakAdayastu naSabdena “saha mupeti” pA॰ samAsAt sidDA si॰ kO॰ । gaRaratne ayaM cAdizu paWitaH । “kiMsvit pratyuta yaccakaccana na kaM satrA samaMsAkamaH” iti tawwIkAyAM “neti nizeDopamAnayorityuktvA udAhftam “nEkaH suptezu jAgfyAt” । “tizWA devo na savitA” iti na savitA savitevetyarTaH” iti । 4 nakArasvarUpavarRe pu॰ । “doDaH sOKyaM mudaM” na iti vf॰ ra॰ wIkA “nogarjinI kzamA” ityAdivarRAtiDAnam । naYarTaSca naYSabde vakzyate । BAve bA॰ qa । 5 banDe pu॰ । nama--karttari karmaRi vA qa । 6 sugate 7 hiraRye ca pu॰ 8 stute tri॰ medi॰ । 9 ratne pu॰ । ekAkzarakozaH ।
m: 1. न the dental nasal (found at the beginning of words and before or after dental consonants as well as between vowels; subject to conversion into ण, Pāṇ. viii, 4, 1-39).

2. न ind. not, no, nor, neither, RV. (ना, x, 34, 8) &c. &c. (as well in simple negation as in wishing, requesting and commanding, except in prohibition before an Impv. or an augmentless aor. [cf. 1. मा]; in successive sentences or clauses either simply repeated, e.g. Mn. iv, 34; or strengthened by another particle, esp. at the second place or further on in the sentence, e.g. by उ [cf. नो], उत, अपि, चापि, वा, वापि or अथ वा, RV. i, 170, 1; 151, 9; Nal. iii, 24, &c.; it may even be replaced by च, वा, अपि च, अपि वा, &c. alone, as, Mn. ii, 98; Nal. i, 14, &c.; often joined with other particles, beside those mentioned above esp. with a following तु, त्व् एव, त्व् एव तु, चेद्, q.v., खलु, q.v., ह [cf. g. चादि and Pāṇ. viii, 1, 31] &c.; before round or collective numbers and after any numeral in the instr. or abl. it expresses deficiency, e.g. एकया न विंशति, not 20 by 1 i.e. 19 ŚBr.; पञ्चभिर् न चत्वारि शतानि, 395 ib.; with another न or an अ priv. it generally forms a strong affirmation [cf. Vām. v, 1, 9] e.g. नेयं न वक्ष्यति, she will most certainly declare, Śak. iii, 9; नादण्ड्यो ऽस्ति, he must certainly be punished, Mn. viii, 335; it may also, like अ, form compounds, Vām. v, 2, 13 [cf. below])
that not, lest, for fear lest (with Pot.), MBh.; R.; Daś. &c.

like, as, as it were (only in Veda and later artificial language, e.g. गौरो न तृषितः पिब, drink like [lit. ‘not’ i.e. ‘although not being’] a thirsty deer; in this sense it does not coalesce metrically with a following vowel).
न [cf. Gk. νη-; Lat. ně-; Angl.Sax. ne, ‘not’; Engl. no, &c.]
a: न — a. 1 Thin, spare. --2 Vacant, empty. --3 Same, identical. --4 Unwearied. --5 Praised. --6 Undivided. --नः 1 A pearl. --2 N. of Gaṇeśa. --3 Wealth, prosperity. --4 A band, tie. --5 War. --6 N. of Buddha. --7 A gift. --ind. (a) A particle of negation equivalent to ‘not,’ ‘no,’ ‘nor,’ ‘neither’, and used in wishing, requesting, or commanding, but not in prohibition before the imperative mood. (b) Used with the potential mood न may sometimes have the force of ‘lest,’ ‘for fear lest,’ ‘that not;’ क्षत्रियैर्धार्यते शस्त्रं नार्तशब्दो भवेदिति Rām. (c) In agrumentative writings न often comes after इति चेत् and means ‘not so.’ (d) When a negative has to be repeated in successive clauses of the same sentence or in different sentences, न may be simply repeated or may be used with particles like उत, च, अपि, चापि, वा &c.; नाधीयीताश्वमारूढो न वृक्षं न च हस्तिनं . न नावं न खरं नोष्ट्रं नेरिणत्थो न यानगः .. Ms. 4. 120; प्रविशंतं न मां कश्चिदपश्यन्नाप्यवारयत् Mb.; Ms. 2. 195; 3. 8, 9; 4. 15; Ś. 6. 17. Sometimes न may not be expressed in the second and other clauses, but represented only by च, वा, अपिवा; संपदि यस्य न हर्षोविपदि विषादो रणे च धीरत्वं H. 1. 33. (e) न is frequently joined with a second न or any other negative particle to intensify or emphasize an assertion; प्रत्युवाच तमृषिर्न तत्त्वतस्त्वां न वेद्मि पुरुषं पुरातनं R. 11. 85; न च न परिचितो न चाप्यगम्यः M. 1. 11; न पुनरलंकारश्रियं न पुष्यति Ś. 1; नादंड्यो नाम राज्ञोऽस्ति Ms. 8. 335; Me. 63, 106; नासौ न काम्यो न च वेद सम्यग् द्रष्टुं न सा R. 6. 30; Śi. 1. 55; Ve. 2. 10. (f) In a few cases न is retained at the beginning of a negative Tatpuruṣa compound; as नाक, नासत्य, नकुल; see P. VI. 3. 75. (g) न is often joined with other particles; नच, नवा, नैव नतु, नचेद्, नखलु &c. &c. (h) It is also used, especially in early Vedic literature, in the sense of ‘like,’ ‘as,’ ‘as it were’; गावो न गव्यूतीरनु; Śi. 20. 4. v. l. --Comp. --असत्यौ (m. du.) Aśvins, the twin physicians of the gods. --एक a. ‘not one’, more than one, several, various. --(कः) an epithet of Viṣṇu. ˚आत्मन् a. of a manifold or diverse nature. (--m.) N. of the Supreme Being. ˚चर a. ‘not living alone’, gregarious, living in society. ˚जः the Supreme Being. ˚धा ind. in many ways, diversely. ˚भेद, ˚रूप a. various, multiform. ˚शस् ind. repeatedly, often. --किंचन a. very poor, beggarly.
